title: Gideon & God
textBlocks:
God WITH Gideon 

Hello Bravehearts
In today’s Bible story, 
God helps Gideon choose 
WHO is in his army
and helps them WIN the battle

Now that Gideon is convinced that the Lord is WITH him
He follows everything the Lord tells him

Gideon’s army was small - WHY?
so that everyone would know that it was because of GOD’s power that they won 
and not Gideon’s mighty army

They even went to battle with 
CLAY POTS & TRUMPETS!
WHO GOES TO BATTLE WITH POTS?
BUT DO YOU KNOW WHAT WAS INSIDE THE POTS?
TORCHES OF FIRE - this was to help them attack the Midianites by surprise
If the torches werent in the jars - the Midianites would have seen then coming and go ready to fight
But by hiding the torches inside the jars - they caught the Midianites by surprise!
